Stop Scams Caucus | Representative Jefferson Shreve Skip to main content Stop Scams Caucus Chairman: Congressman Jefferson Shreve  Co-Chairs: Representatives Gabe Amo (D-RI-01), Zach Nunn (R-IA-03), and Jamie Raskin (D-MD-08) In 2024, the FBI received reports of $16.6 billion in losses to scams, though experts believe true losses could be over $196 billion annually for Americans. Scams are increasingly driven by sophisticated international networks, making prevention and enforcement a growing challenge. About the Caucus The bipartisan Stop Scams Caucus is committed to protecting Americans from financial fraud, cyber scams, and cross-border criminal networks. With scams costing Americans tens of billions of dollars each year, the caucus serves as a central hub in Congress to raise awareness, advance policy solutions, and coordinate with public and private partners working to safeguard the public. Social Media: Follow the Stop Scams Caucus on X .  More on Stop Scams Caucus Image Congressman Shreve Designates December 4 as “National Scam Prevention Day” December 4, 2025 Press Release Washington, DC — Congressman Jefferson Shreve (R-IN) today introduced a resolution designating December 4, 2025, as National Scam Prevention Day, underscoring the growing need for a coordinated national effort to help Americans identify, report, and prevent scams. Indiana ranks second nationwide for phishing scams . Every year, countless citizens fall victim to increasingly sophisticated schemes. Issues : Stop Scams Caucus As Holiday Scams Ramp Up, Shreve Advances His Scam Taskforce Bill to the House Floor December 3, 2025 Press Release Washington, D.C. — With holiday scams surging, Congressman Jefferson Shreve (R-IN) announced that his standalone Dismantle Foreign Scam Syndicates Act has passed out of the House Foreign Affairs Committee today and is headed to the House Floor. This marks the latest push in Rep. Shreve’s broader effort to crack down on international scam networks that are stealing billions from Americans — often targeting seniors and vulnerable families. Shreve Hosts Wayne County Veterans Roundtable | Representative Jefferson Shreve Skip to main content Shreve Hosts Wayne County Veterans Roundtable June 18, 2026 Press Release RICHMOND, IN — Congressman Jefferson Shreve (IN-06) hosted a veterans roundtable at Richmond City Hall to hear directly from Wayne County veterans about access to care, VA services, and the Richmond VA Clinic. Wayne County is home to more than 4,000 veterans. The discussion focused on how local veterans use the VA system, where it is working, and where Congress can help improve service and access. “Wayne County veterans served this country, and they’ve earned care that is timely, reliable, and close to home,” said Rep. Shreve. “This roundtable was about listening directly to the men and women who use the VA system. Their experience matters, and it will help guide my work in Congress as we keep pressing for better care and stronger support for Hoosier veterans.” In Congress, Rep. Shreve has supported legislation to strengthen veterans’ benefits and health care. He has cosponsored the Major Richard Star Act and the Veterans’ ACCESS Act of 2025, and supported $1.64 billion through the 2027 appropriations process for a new VA medical center in Indianapolis. Shreve Announces Mobile Office Hours in Fortville | Representative Jefferson Shreve Skip to main content Shreve Announces Mobile Office Hours in Fortville August 7, 2026 Press Release Greenwood, IN – Congressman Jefferson Shreve (IN-06) announced today that his constituent services team will hold mobile office hours to assist Hoosiers on Wednesday, August 12th in Fortville. During these events, constituents can meet directly with members of Congressman Shreve’s staff to help resolve issues with federal agencies such as the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Internal Revenue Service (IRS), and Social Security Administration (SSA). "Our mobile office hours bring constituent services directly to communities across the Sixth District,”  said Congressman Shreve.  “If you’re having trouble with a federal agency, my team stands ready to help.” If constituents are unable to attend these events, Congressman Shreve also maintains a district office in Greenwood, open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The office can be reached by phone at (317) 399-3333. Mobile Office Hours Details: Fortville, Indiana Date: Wednesday, August 12  Time: 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM Location: Fortville Town Hall 714 E. Broadway, Fortville, IN 46040 Media Press Releases In the News Shreve Summary Back to top button

Shreve Celebrates Historic Freedom 250 Grand Prix | Representative Jefferson Shreve Skip to main content Shreve Celebrates Historic Freedom 250 Grand Prix August 21, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON — Congressman Jefferson Shreve (IN-06) released the following statement ahead of the Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, D.C.: "This weekend, INDYCAR will make history on the streets of our nation’s capital. Drivers will race past monuments that tell America’s story — and the country will see what Hoosiers have known for generations: There’s nothing quite like INDYCAR racing! "Race day is unlike anything else: the smell of fuel and hot asphalt. The roar down the straightaway — and a crowd holding its breath. It is engineering, innovation and competition on full display. "Auto racing is woven into Indiana’s identity. Bringing our proud tradition to Washington is a fitting way to celebrate America’s 250th anniversary. Mary and I wish every driver a safe, fast race. And as we say in Indy: Drivers, start your engines!” Last month, Rep. Shreve introduced a House resolution supporting the Freedom 250 and recognizing the contributions of INDYCAR, the Indianapolis 500 and the Hoosiers who have made Indiana the racing capital of the world. Every Republican member of Indiana’s House delegation joined the resolution. Read the full resolution here . Media Press Releases In the News Shreve Summary Back to top button

Rep. Shreve Statement on Recent Flooding Across Indiana | Representative Jefferson Shreve Skip to main content Rep. Shreve Statement on Recent Flooding Across Indiana August 14, 2026 Press Release GREENWOOD, IN – Today, Congressman Jefferson Shreve released the following statement on the severe flooding affecting communities across Indiana: “My thoughts and prayers are with everyone affected by the severe storms and flooding across Indiana. Over the past three days, communities across our state — including several in the 6th District — have been hit hard. I’m grateful to the first responders, emergency crews, and local and state officials working around the clock to keep people safe and begin assessing the damage. My office is closely coordinating with Governor Braun and state and local officials. We stand ready to help however we can. And at the federal level, I’ll work to make sure our communities have the support they need to recover and rebuild. Indiana communities look out for one another. We’ve seen that again over the past 72 hours, and we’ll see it in the days ahead.” Media Press Releases In the News Shreve Summary Back to top button
